info.title: PullBoard API
info.description: Adds nullable current project, cached Jira assignee emails and per-type status choices. Editors start Unassigned/No sprint/no transition; create status remains name-based. Context current sprints are configured-pattern active matches; selectors retain all board active/future sprints. Jira choice discovery occurs only during normal refresh and publishes atomically with source data; existing Jira SourceHealth covers cache freshness. Same-origin local-only API: all POSTs require X-PullBoard-Request: 1, strict JSON and allowed browser Origin; reject non-loopback Host/authority and duplicate security headers. No permissive CORS. All API responses are no-store, errors use ErrorResponse and no secrets/raw upstream errors are exposed. Unknown request/query fields are rejected. See CONTRACT.md for normative security, identity scope, admission, transition and atomic-cache invariants.

get.summary: Read verified identities, current configured project and matching active sprints

200.description: Sanitized application context; discovery-pending arrays may be empty and current_project null, see source health

get.summary: Read the application-wide runtime Jira action mode and revision

200.description: One atomic mode/revision pair; runtime override is never persisted

post.summary: Explicitly change the application-wide runtime mode
post.description: Compare expected_mode_revision and update mode/revision atomically. A no-op with the matching token preserves revision. Every actual toggle and process restart issues a fresh never-reused opaque token. Live changes require frontend confirmation. This affects only subsequent admissions; already admitted live actions may finish after switching to test. No YAML/cache persistence, upstream calls or refresh scheduling. Never automatically retry a conflict.

200.description: Coherent cached snapshot including open assigned non-PR upstream issues

get.summary: Read coherent refresh health, per-source phases, counts and elapsed times

200.description: Live process-local progress and health, independent of retained board card counts

get.description: Unknown query keys are rejected. Omitting issue_type selects the resolved purpose default, or null if unavailable. Read only the complete refresh-time cache: no upstream metadata/group/user discovery. query filters cached username/display name/exposed email, never defaults or authorization. Omit query to load the full eligible pool for local instant filtering. Group policy is server-side and committed atomically on successful refresh. Retained last-good options remain usable with stale Jira SourceHealth from Board/SyncStatus; without an initial usable scoped cache return 503 jira_not_ready or 502 jira_discovery_failed. Never silently return unrestricted/partial pools.

200.description: Complete cached options, null assignee/sprint defaults, capabilities and safe diagnostics; freshness uses Jira source health

post.summary: Generate an editable AI or template ticket draft
Explicitly create a Jira ticket or simulate creation
post.description: After security/structural checks, compare expected_mode_revision and capture mode atomically before any upstream call or business validation. A mismatch returns mode_conflict, zero upstream calls, no automatic retry. Every step/follow-up uses admitted mode even if runtime mode later changes. Simulated actions perform zero Jira writes, invent no IDs/cache data and schedule no write refresh.

200.description: Created or explicitly simulated, according to the mode captured at admission

post.summary: Explicitly link one cached PR to a Jira issue
post.description: Same atomic mode admission/precondition as createIssue; use the original user-confirmed revision, not the latest polled revision. Existing many-to-many scope and duplicate-link idempotency are unchanged. Simulated actions perform zero Jira writes and schedule no write refresh. Never automatically retry mode_conflict.

200.description: Linked, duplicate, or simulated, according to the mode captured at admission

post.summary: Read an issue URL on a configured forge instance without adding it to the board
post.description: Read-only, no mode revision or Jira readiness needed. Validate configured origin/base-path and canonical issue route before upstream calls; reject userinfo/query/fragment/traversal, PR/MR routes and payload markers. No redirects or arbitrary URL fetching. source_id:null selects a unique matching instance, otherwise require explicit selection. Respect repository policy. May return closed/unassigned issues with a closed warning. Store trusted content separately from Board, scoped to current verified source/service/principal/policy; the returned issue.id remains usable for draft/create until eviction/restart/scope invalidation. See CONTRACT.md for required security and storage semantics.

200.description: Trusted issue and nullable closed warning; no board/cache publication

post.summary: Build a deterministic editable implementation draft from a trusted upstream issue
post.description: Read-only; no AI or mode revision. Accept a verified board issue or separately stored manual resolution, including closed/unassigned issues. Use the configured source default project (fallback first YAML Jira project) and existing implementation options/default resolver. Preserve exact title and normalized description, append trusted upstream URL and labels as plain text. Story points/status start null; warn if closed. Never copy comments/attachments, mutate Board, or scan Jira for duplicates.

200.description: Editable deterministic template with implementation defaults and diagnostics

post.summary: Explicitly create Jira from an upstream issue or simulate it
post.description: Strict structural/security checks then identical atomic expected_mode_revision admission as createIssue, before selector lookup/business validation/upstream calls. Lookup server-trusted board/manual issue in current verified source/principal/policy scope; manual issues need not be open/assigned/on Board. Revalidate existing implementation Jira options/choices. Live create adds the trusted issue web link and explicitly selected supported follow-ups. Reuse CreateIssueResult including accepted-write unknown-key and post-create warning safeguards. Simulated actions perform zero upstream writes, fabricate no IDs/cache data and schedule no write refresh. No deduplication, clone tracking, Jira scans, automatic replay or standalone linking-scope expansion.

200.description: Created or explicitly simulated according to admitted mode; shared create outcome safeguards

ModeConflict.description: 409 mode_conflict: stale or unknown expected_mode_revision; rejected before admission/upstream calls. Refresh mode, preserve edits and require a new explicit user confirmation; never auto-retry. Other existing action-conflict codes may also use 409.

error.message: Runtime mode changed. Review the current mode and submit again explicitly.

ModeRevision.description: Opaque equality-only token for one process-wide mode state; fresh on every restart and actual toggle, never reused even when toggling back. Not a board revision, timestamp, authentication secret or idempotency key. Missing/null/empty/overlong/non-string requests are 400 invalid_request; any well-formed mismatched value is 409 mode_conflict.

RuntimeMode.description: One atomically sampled application-wide mode/revision pair. Initialized from YAML on restart, runtime changes are never persisted. true simulates Jira actions; false permits explicitly submitted live Jira writes. Forge adapters are always read-only.

ChangeRuntimeModeRequest.description: Explicit user submission; confirmation required in the UI when changing to live. Capture the expected revision when the confirmation opens; do not replace it with a newer polled token. Compare-and-change is atomic; matching no-op preserves the revision. Switching to test does not revoke admitted live actions.

JiraAssignee.description: Cached eligible active human Jira account; purpose-specific review self exclusion applies. Person fields plus nullable email, present only if exposed upstream, never inferred or fetched via extra per-user checks. Does not alter Person elsewhere.

Identity.description: Verified current upstream principal only; never synthesized from configuration. account_id is scoped by source_id and service URL.

Sprint.description: Board/options retain every active/future sprint returned by the configured board, including foreign-origin sprints. Context.current_sprints contains only default_eligible entries. board_id/board_url identify the queried board, not ownership. Derive a sprint view by setting selectedSprint on the trusted board_url using URL query encoding. team is a reliably discovered ownership display name or null. default_eligible is active AND a full configured name-pattern match, not an availability restriction or creation default. No synthetic eligible-active filter option.

Attention.description: coverage describes per-item upstream attention history only; partial remains valid and never implies unhealthy source refresh.

JiraIssue.description: Non-Closed Jira issue assigned to the verified user in configured projects, or a mention-search candidate from any accessible project regardless of assignee. Overview includes only configured-project issues assigned to the verified user. Only status Closed is excluded, not resolution or Done status category. Discovery uses separate fully paginated server-side assigned and mention JQL searches without a date cutoff, never a project-wide scan or unfiltered fallback. Mention JQL is status != "Closed" AND (description ~ currentUser() OR comment ~ currentUser()). Matches are deduplicated by upstream issue ID before per-issue history reads; explicit mentions and upstream reply history determine attention, which is null for handled or false positive matches. See CONTRACT.md for query and failure semantics. Cross-project mention discovery does not expand configured metadata projects or authorize writes outside configured projects.

UpstreamIssue.description: Trusted non-PR/MR issue on a configured GitHub/GitLab/Codeberg/Forgejo instance. Board retains only open issues assigned to the verified principal after complete assignment-scoped discovery and repository policy. Manual resolution may return closed/unassigned issues without adding them to Board. id is stable and scoped by source/repository/item kind, never a PR ID or authorization token. owner is the namespace, including nested GitLab groups. Reporter may be null for unavailable/deleted authors; assignees include self. Description/labels are normalized plain text. No attention, clone status or Jira dedup fields.

ResolveUpstreamIssueRequest.description: Both fields required. Null source_id chooses the unique configured instance by derived web origin/base-path/issue route; ambiguity is 422 ambiguous_upstream_source. Explicit source_id must match. GitHub https://api.github.com/ maps only to https://github.com/; Enterprise /api/v3 suffix is removed on the same origin. Other bases are unchanged, never inferred from redirects/client content. Server validates exact web origin/path, repository policy, no PR/MR route/payload, userinfo/query/fragment/traversal or redirects before storing trusted content. Semantic URL security is normative, not guaranteed by URI syntax alone.

ResolvedUpstreamIssue.description: Stored separately from Board in a bounded process-local trusted resolution store, keyed by issue.id within current verified source/service/principal/repository-policy scope. Board and stored IDs both work for draft/create; scoped manual content takes precedence if the ID also occurs on Board. No extra bearer token or client content is accepted. Survives ordinary board refreshes without being overwritten, not eviction/restart/scope invalidation (404 upstream_issue_not_found). Closed issues require a visible nonblank warning; open issues have warning:null.

UpstreamIssueDraftRequest.description: Select a trusted board/manual issue by opaque ID. Null project uses source default_project then first configured YAML Jira project. Implementation only, deterministic, no AI or writes. Nullable project_key is still required.

UpstreamIssueDraft.description: Existing editable draft shape with upstream_issue_id instead of PR ID; purpose always implementation, generated_by always template (never AI). Exact title and normalized issue description plus trusted URL/labels as text, per CONTRACT.md. Implementation cached options/defaults/diagnostics; assignee_id, sprint_id, story_points and suggested_status initially null. Optional empty inputs produce no warning diagnostics. warning is the closed-issue warning or null. No comments/attachments or clone tracking. Draft text is not silently truncated to final-create limits.

CreateUpstreamIssueRequest.description: Dedicated implementation clone submission. All fields required including nullable editor fields. Same committed-cache Jira choice/capability validation as CreateIssueRequest, no group/user/metadata rediscovery. status is a uniquely resolving cached project/type status name, not ID; null means Jira default/no transition. Explicit live selection permits at most one direct post-create transition, no-op if already there; failure is created success plus warning, never rollback/retry/multi-hop/duplicate create. Simulated mode performs zero writes. expected_mode_revision atomically admits before selector lookup/business validation/upstream calls. upstream_issue_id selects trusted board/manual content in current verified scope, including closed/unassigned manual issues. Link URL/title come only from trusted content. No AI, upstream writes, Jira dedup search, clone tracking or automatic replay.

team.description: Current implementation project/type teams[].id or null, not arbitrary text.

SourceHealth.description: Successful complete refresh is always ok, including with neutral nonempty coverage_notes. No partial source status. Attention.coverage is independent. Jira health covers the complete refresh-time choice cache too; last_success_at marks atomic publication of Jira data and choices. error/backoff retain only the verified account/service/committed-policy last-good snapshot/choices/notes and flag them stale. Board holds published health; SyncStatus may report a current failure before publication. last_attempt_at is actual attempt start, not skipped backoff time.

SourceProgress.description: Process-local per-source attempt progress; reset all entries at each new job, not on coalescing. Counts are unique fully hydrated/evaluated Jira issues, PRs and upstream issues (both forge collections), not pages/requests/cards; deduplicate by source/repository/item kind before hydration. Unknown total is null, known total >= completed; publishing/completed total equals completed, including 0/0 for an empty source. Numeric comparisons are normative cross-field invariants, see CONTRACT.md. elapsed_ms is monotonic attempt duration, excludes queue/skipped backoff, samples while active and freezes terminally; never restores old-run progress. Discovery/fetching may interleave. Backoff skipped without attempt has the zero/null reset shape; in-attempt backoff retains actual work and timing.

Board.description: Atomic source snapshot; upstream_issues is always present, open assigned non-PR issues only. Forge PR and issue collections replace/retain together under one source health/principal. Manual resolutions never enter this array or advance revision. Upstream issues sort by case-insensitive title/stable ID, with independent display filters and no attention/clone status.

Health.description: Mode and mode_revision are sampled atomically from runtime state, not immutable YAML. Do not combine pairs from separate HTTP responses.

Project.description: Successfully discovered configured project and allowed create issue-type names; no YAML metadata or shared purpose defaults. jira_projects preserves YAML project order; current_project is the first configured project's discovered value, never an arbitrary available project.

Context.description: Mode and mode_revision are sampled atomically from runtime state. Poll this pair or runtime-mode for cross-tab changes; never silently rebase open dialogs. current_project is the discovered first configured YAML Jira project or null while unavailable/disabled. current_sprints contains only configured-pattern active matches sorted by case-insensitive name then ID for display, not selection priority. Overview initially/reset selects an actual ID only with exactly one match; zero/multiple matches use an explicit no-current/choose-sprint state with empty Jira results until deliberate filter selection, never an automatic first choice, union or all-sprints fallback. Header may show matching candidates but must explain multiple-match ambiguity and exclude nonmatches. Attention defaults to all including no sprint. Preserve deliberate per-tab filters across refreshes.

SyncStatus.description: Coherent process-local status. progress has exactly one entry for each configured source, matching sources by unique source_id in the same order; no other IDs. Board stays visible until atomic publication. A new accepted job resets all progress and clears finished_at; coalescing does not. started_at is job enqueue time. last_success_at advances only when all sources succeed and publication commits, never when a source fails/is skipped for backoff. Zero sources is a successful no-op. Live source health can surface failure before Board publication. All timing/progress resets on process restart.

Workflow.description: Purpose-specific suggestions for the linked PR's state; null means no configured suggestion. Never authorizes background transitions.

TeamChoice.description: Opaque server-issued selection key and discovered display name; not a custom field ID or arbitrary text. Backend privately maps the key to a typed permitted upstream value.

StatusChoice.description: Real upstream status ID/name from the selected project's issue-type group in GET /rest/api/3/project/{key}/statuses. Deduplicate by ID and sort name case-insensitively then ID. Inventory is not proof of an available direct transition. Existing create status uses the exact uniquely resolving name, not ID.

FieldCapability.description: For the selected issue type. Only create/follow_up authorize a non-null value. follow_up is advertised only for an actually implemented discovered mechanism; unknown never authorizes a write. required describes the upstream requirement, not configured default policy.

CreateCapabilities.description: Metadata feasibility, not authorization or validation of filled form values. can_create iff blockers is empty and a type is selected. Required supported inputs can still be blank in a draft; final create must validate them. Unsupported/unknown required fields add blockers. Optional unsupported fields do not block an otherwise valid create with null values.

unassigned_allowed.description: False until positively supported for the selected project/type; true permits explicit null assignee.

JiraDefaults.description: issue_type is the supported configured purpose default or null, even when an explicit query selects a different type. assignee_id and sprint_id are always null: Unassigned/No sprint for every new editor, regardless of self/current sprint/legacy configured me. workflow retains configured suggestions, never automatic editor selection/transition. Team is resolved against the selected type; missing optional defaults are normal, not warnings. Search query never changes defaults.

JiraOptions.description: One complete cached generation, scoped to verified account/service/configured projects/committed group policy. Refresh preloads every allowed type's choices. No discovery or per-user checks on reads/drafts/create. Jira SourceHealth in Board/SyncStatus supplies freshness; retained stale complete cache is usable, absent cache returns readiness/discovery error. All board active/future sprints remain selectable independent of team. statuses is the selected type's inventory, not a promise of direct transition permission.

TicketDraft.description: Editable AI/template draft. Review titles are set by the backend as Review <repository>/<number>: <PR title>, using the repository name without owner/namespace and repository-local PR/MR number, limited to 255 characters regardless of AI output. assignee_id, sprint_id and suggested_status initially null for both purposes: Unassigned/No sprint/Jira default (no transition), including when configured workflow suggestions exist. Optional empty inputs produce no warning diagnostics. Options and validation use the refresh-time choice cache.

CreateIssueRequest.description: expected_mode_revision is captured with the displayed mode when the editor opens; never replaced on polling. Admission captures immutable mode before business validation/upstream calls. Validate choices against the latest committed cache, with no choice discovery/per-user checks; Jira enforces current write permission. status remains an exact unique cached statuses[].name or null for Jira default/no transition. Explicit live status selection permits at most one direct post-create transition: no-op if already there, otherwise unavailable/failed transition returns created success plus nonblocking warning, never rollback/retry/multi-hop/duplicate create. Simulated mode performs zero writes. Later toggles cannot upgrade a simulation or revoke admitted live follow-ups.

team.description: A teams[].id from current project/type discovery or null, never arbitrary team text or a field ID.

CreateIssueResult.description: A created outcome is an accepted live write, not permission to retry creation. Normally issue contains the real confirmed key/URL/title. If Jira accepted creation but returned no safely usable key (including a malformed/truncated success body), created may have issue:null only with at least one nonblank warning explaining the limitation and discouraging resubmission. Never fabricate an issue reference or cache entry. Clients handle this as success with warnings, no issue link and no create retry; normal write-triggered refresh still applies. simulated always requires issue:null and zero Jira writes.

warnings: The issue could not be safely linked or transitioned; do not resubmit creation.

LinkRequest.description: Use the original mode revision shown when the link dialog/explicit gesture was initiated. Backend checks and snapshots mode atomically before upstream calls/business validation. No arbitrary upstream URL, batch or unlink support.
